name: QuiX Quantum
description: QuiX Quantum builds photonic quantum processors based on silicon nitride waveguide technology, requiring no cryogenic cooling. The company has deployed over 15 systems worldwide, including 8-qubit and 64-qubit photonic quantum computers to the German Aerospace Centre (DLR), and secured EUR 15M in Series A funding to deliver a universal photonic quantum computer.

sources.title: Enschede-based QuiX Quantum secures EUR 15M to launch first universal photonic quantum computer
